Inspection / Maintenance Item: Is the meter(s) properly calibrated or "proved" at the appropriate time intervals?
Is the seal(s) in place by the appropriate authority having jurisdiction?
Is the meter in good working condition and free of leaks?
Has the strainer been properly cleaned out of any debris?
Are the hose covers free of exposed reinforcement?
Is wire braid reinforcement free of kinks and not flattened?
Are hoses free of soft spots when not under pressure, show no bulging under pressure, and have no loose outer coverings?
Are hose coupling assemblies secure and in good working condition?
Are the ACME threads, O-rings, or gaskets in good working condition (i.e., showing little sign of excessive wear)?
Are pull-away couplings in place and in good working condition?
